note: All materials are internal. plan_material.py --audience-profile picks one (default business); lint_material.py reads the plan's terminology sets for TERM_BRAND. internal is the shared AP set (references/terminology.json) plus the project's house terms; any other set (clinical-partners) is optional and loads only when the project's terminology file (brand profile "terminology") defines it. Unknown profile names fail AUDIENCE_PROFILE.

business.label: Non-technical business users
business.tone: plain, answer first, every term defined
business.jargon: define every term at first use; no system or tool names

leaders.label: Leaders and executives
leaders.tone: bottom line first, decisions and asks up front
leaders.jargon: define every term; no system or tool names

technical.label: Technical teams
technical.tone: precise and complete; exact names of systems, fields and steps
technical.jargon: glossary allowed; system and tool names allowed

clinical-partners.label: Clinical partners
clinical-partners.jargon: define business terms; clinical terms allowed

physicians.label: Physicians
physicians.tone: brief and direct; the ask in the first line
physicians.jargon: define business terms; clinical terms allowed

frontline.label: Frontline operations
frontline.tone: short steps, one action per line, what to do now
frontline.jargon: define every term; screen labels exactly as shown
